newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steniel says high-cost inventory sold out.
newsitem.headline: Steniel says high-cost inventory sold out.

text.p: Corrugated box maker Steniel Manufacturing Corp said on Wednesday it had sold its inventory of boxes which were produced with expensive raw materials.
"We've already disposed all our high-cost inventory. What we have now are at market price already," a Steniel official told Reuters.

The company posted a net loss of 127.2 million pesos in the first nine months of the year after the price of paper plummetted early this year which the company said affected profits because of its "higher than normal inventory".
Steniel slid four centavos to 2.32 pesos by midsession Wednesday. It has been on the uptrend since late last week.
Steniel is a subsidiary of diversified holding firm Metro Pacific Corp. Metro is the flagship company of First Pacific Co Ltd.
